name: alkemy
description: Fitness training in ChatGPT: see the workouts your coach planned, your history and progress, and log workouts in Alkemy.

interface.longDescription:
Alkemy is a fitness and strength training app. Coaches plan workouts for their athletes, and athletes log what they did.

Connect your Alkemy athlete account to ask about today's workout, look back at your training, and check your progress. Tell ChatGPT what you did, and it logs the workout or the run for you, so your coach sees it in Alkemy. Log your sets while you train, and swap an exercise when the equipment is taken: the swap changes only your version, never your coach's plan.

You need an Alkemy athlete account: your coach invites you. ChatGPT can only read and log your own training. It cannot see your injuries, bodyweight or payment details, and you can disconnect it at any time in Alkemy under Profile, Connected apps.

Alkemy is a training tool. It does not give medical advice.
